subtitle: To-dos kept on your own server
promotionalText: Your lists and tasks, kept in the substrate you run, and on every device you sign in to.
description:
Substrate Tasks is a to-do list that lives in your substrate, the personal server you run or choose. Your lists and tasks are records on that server, so they stay yours: there is no account with us, and nothing goes anywhere else.

• Tasks with a due day or a due time, and a priority
• Lists in the order you choose
• Reminders when a task is due
• Works offline: changes wait on your device and are sent when you are back online
• Updates live when something changes on your server
• On iPhone, iPad and Mac

Substrate Tasks is a client for a substrate. Sign in with your server's address and approve what the app may do there: it asks only for your lists and tasks.
